title: Distinct armor items (mail shirt: 'blunts every blow just by riding in your pack'; tarred oilskin coat: 'turns a blade well'; watch shield: 'it has stopped worse than claws') each carry their own descriptive text implying a bonus, but status only ever shows one combined 'armor+N' figure, so there's no way to confirm whether picking up a second or third piece actually changed anything.
